response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile engineer with ~15 years across web, mobile, embedded and open-source work, and some genuine low-latency/high-throughput distributed systems exposure (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby, millions of HTTP requests per second) plus DevOps/Kubernetes and mentoring/teaching credentials. However, the role's hard requirement of 8 years of C++ is not close to being met — the resume shows roughly 6 months of C/C++ work at National Instruments plus a university thesis project, with the bulk of his career in TypeScript/Node.js and D. There is also no evidence of leading technical strategy for a cloud compute platform, production cloud architecture ownership at scale, or a formal technical-leadership role over cloud/DevOps engineers. Strong generalist, but a poor match for this specific systems/C++ leadership position.
strengths: Broad 15-year engineering track record, including low-latency, high-throughput microservices
Demonstrated mentoring/teaching: workshops, courses, dojos, conference talks
Founder of an open-source platform with Kubernetes deployment and full ownership
concerns: Far short of the 8-year C++ requirement (~6 months professional C/C++)
No cloud compute platform strategy or production cloud architecture leadership shown
Recent work is web/full-stack and AI tooling, not large-scale infrastructure
